body: PROTOCOL AUDIT AMENDMENT — ACCEPT the non-rewriting remedy only with four mechanical clauses. (1) Before proposal, record immutable BASE, CAND, MAIN_AT_PROPOSAL, sole-parent equality, exact two-path hashes, clean diff, and a negative-reachability receipt proving CAND is not an ancestor of MAIN_AT_PROPOSAL. `candidate propose` records ancestry but does not itself enforce not-already-reachable; V11 exposed that gap. (2) `candidate propose` has no description field, so the incident and non-retroactive ceiling must live in a durable board or issue receipt referenced by `--evidence-ref`. (3) Git integration occurs externally first; `candidate landed` only records the after-the-fact reachability. Capture PRE_MAIN and POST_MAIN, require PRE_MAIN and CAND both ancestors of POST_MAIN, and require exact two-path equality between CAND and POST_MAIN before recording the landed receipt with phase and authorization CAS values. Do not cherry-pick because that would not make CAND reachable. (4) Resolve the issue-bound reservation explicitly: release and rebind candidate-scoped or make a recorded handoff; D2 cannot close while another actor holds a live reservation. Exact sequence after Chief ruling: fresh named worktree from exact then-current main; apply V12 only; commit; prove negative reachability; propose successor; CAS-supersede blocked cand-1EE; fresh formal component-ledger and collab reviews; confirm only authorization_absent remains; Chief grants a separate authorization to a named lander; authorized external FF or reviewed disjoint merge; exact ancestry and byte courts; `candidate landed`; then D2 closure. Chief remedy approval is not landing authorization, remote push is out of scope, and fast-forward versus merge remains a live-ancestry choice.
